title: [挑戦しよう] カテゴリ平均より売れている商品
statement:
products と order_items から、同じカテゴリの商品平均より売上数量が多い商品を表示してください。出力する列は category, product_name, sold_quantity, category_average です。

売上がない商品も平均計算には sold_quantity = 0 として含めます。category_average は ROUND(平均, 1) で小数1桁にします。category の昇順、product_name の昇順で並べます。

constraints.name: 0件の扱い
constraints.value: 売上がない商品も sold_quantity 0 として平均に含めます

constraints.name: 平均との比較
constraints.value: 商品ごとの売上数量がカテゴリ平均より大きい商品だけを残します

starterSql:
WITH product_sales AS (
  SELECT
    products.id,
    products.category,
    products.name AS product_name
    -- 商品ごとの sold_quantity を出します
  FROM products
  LEFT JOIN order_items
    ON order_items.product_id = products.id
  GROUP BY products.id, products.category, products.name
), category_average AS (
  SELECT
    category
    -- カテゴリ平均を出します
  FROM product_sales
  GROUP BY category
)
SELECT
  product_sales.category,
  product_sales.product_name,
  product_sales.sold_quantity,
  ROUND(category_average.avg_quantity, 1) AS category_average
FROM product_sales
JOIN category_average
  ON category_average.category = product_sales.category
WHERE product_sales.sold_quantity > category_average.avg_quantity
ORDER BY product_sales.category ASC, product_sales.product_name ASC;
solutionSql:
WITH product_sales AS (
  SELECT
    products.id,
    products.category,
    products.name AS product_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(CAST(order_items.quantity AS INTEGER)), 0) AS sold_quantity
  FROM products
  LEFT JOIN order_items
    ON order_items.product_id = products.id
  GROUP BY products.id, products.category, products.name
), category_average AS (
  SELECT
    category,
    AVG(sold_quantity) AS avg_quantity
  FROM product_sales
  GROUP BY category
)
SELECT
  product_sales.category,
  product_sales.product_name,
  product_sales.sold_quantity,
  ROUND(category_average.avg_quantity, 1) AS category_average
FROM product_sales
JOIN category_average
  ON category_average.category = product_sales.category
WHERE product_sales.sold_quantity > category_average.avg_quantity
ORDER BY product_sales.category ASC, product_sales.product_name ASC;

tests.name: 売上なしも平均に含める
